repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

**Acceptance amended** · 2026-11-26T14:14Z · per card #37499 (maintainer-directed, child of topic #36229)

Acceptance item 1 gains one clause: the addendum also says that **no write lands on a hidden item**. While its package is disabled, a package-less row at a name only disabled packages hold is the holder's customization. It hides with the holder for reads and writes alike: a save, publish, delete or draft discard of it is refused, so re-enabling serves it back unchanged.

PR #37584 (Fixes #37499) carries a dated ADR-0150 D3 note to this effect. When this card's addendum is written, cite #37499 beside #33385 / #33401 / #34144, and keep the two consistent. The card body is left as triage wrote it; this comment is the amendment of record.

repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

**Coverage note · 2026-11-26T19:15Z · PR #37584 merged (Fixes #37499)**

没有写入落在被隐藏的项上：包停用期间，不带包名的保存、存草稿、删除、撤草稿都被拒绝且不改动任何存储行（#37584，ADR-0150 D3 注记已补写入一侧）。其中有配套定制包且行可迁移的那一格，保存、存草稿、删除由 ADR-0146 D11 收口先行拒绝（403），该格的提示用语待维护者决策卡定。单项发布与单项回滚两扇门尚未判断，由 #37608 跟进，这两扇门落地前本条对它们不成立。

(English: no write lands on a hidden item — while a package is disabled, a save, draft save, delete or draft discard naming no package is refused and moves no stored row (#37584, with the write side now in ADR-0150's D3 note). In the D11 cells (a paired customization package, a movable row) the save, draft save and delete are refused first by the ADR-0146 D11 close (`403`); that sentence's wording awaits a maintainer decision card. The per-item publish and rollback doors are not yet judged and are tracked by #37608; until they land this statement does not cover them. This tightens to a universal statement once the decision card is ruled and #37608 merges.)

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:package · domain:server · Task · p3 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: a docs gap. ADR-0150 and the package-disable API page do not state what a disabled package does to its names and their customizations. The maintainer has since ruled that a disabled package must vanish everywhere (topic #36229, 「停用就该全部消失」), so the addendum and the API page must state that rule, not the older narrower reading this card quotes. A docs omission with no misteaching stays p3 (audit restatement, tier 3). Graded, not chased (area:package has no seat). Recorded 2026-11-27T09:17Z.
